refreshNotes: Naming/trim refresh. B4 (FWD only, 194 hp) becomes the new standard powertrain, replacing the prior turbo-only T-engines. B5 (AWD, 247 hp) remains the uplevel option. Trim ladder: B4 Core, B4 Plus, B5 Core, B5 Plus, B5 Ultra, B5 Ultra Black Edition. Source: https://www.media.volvocars.com/us/en-us/media/pressreleases/338590/volvo-car-usa-2025-model-year-pricing-and-change
